arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.opt.job: I have a job for you.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.opt.fetch_: Bring, make or dig up something...
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.opt.cancel: Drop what you are doing now.
arcane_artifacts.page1.catto_talk: Use Catto with an empty hand and the camera swings over your shoulder like in a film: you and Catto in the frame, black bars above and below, Catto's line as subtitles at the bottom, your answers on the right (or keys 1-9). Catto stands and listens while you talk. "I have a job": a block in your off hand - it digs up the same around you; any item in your off hand - it brings or makes it; it can also gather what lies around or explore.
arcane_artifacts.page2.catto_talk: "I need protection" - Catto guards a place (fights monsters within 12 blocks of its post) or escorts you (stays close and hits whatever comes at you); the queue waits meanwhile. "What are you up to?" - plans, cancel, pause. "Show me what you carry" - gear. Space skips to the end of a line.
arcane_artifacts.page1.catto_nature: Catto's temperament is set at birth. A Brawler pounces on monsters and bonds through fights. A Gentle one always backs away and loves petting. A Curious one picks up everything and is a born explorer. A Lazy one works slower and adores being petted. A Thrifty one takes only what is useful, sometimes saves material and hits back when hit. Each has its own starting skills and its own way of talking.
arcane_artifacts.catto.tool.trowel: In Catto's paws: builds twice as fast and reaches further.
arcane_artifacts.catto.tool.rod: In Catto's paws: fishes when free, near water and with you around.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.greet0.cur: Oh! What is that? Where are we going? Can I see?
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.greet0.laz: Mrr... I am not asleep. I am thinking. With my eyes closed.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.greet0.thr: Hello. The accounts are kept, the stores in order. Almost.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.greet1.cur: I found a pebble! An ordinary one. But so ordinary!
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.greet1.laz: You came... Good. I can lie next to you.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.greet1.thr: Did you know there are three spare sticks in the chest? I did.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.greet2.cur: Hi! What shall we do? Something new?
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.greet2.thr: I am listening. Keep it to the point.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.jobs.curio: Work? Interesting work? Let us go!
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.jobs.lazy: Oh. Work. Well... what is it?
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.jobs.thrif: What do we do? Say how many right away.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.how_many.c: How many? Lots? Lots and lots?
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.how_many.l: How many? Fewer would be nice...
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.hint_sampl: Show me! Hold it in your off hand - I will look, sniff and understand.
Hold a sample in your off hand... It is easier for me.
A sample in your off hand. A block - I dig it up, a thing - I bring or make it.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.hint_build: Building! Mark the corners with the Wand, material in the off hand. Or a blueprint - I love blueprints!
Mark the corners with the Errand Wand... material in the off hand. I will do it. Soon.
Corners with the Wand, material in the off hand, waste nothing.
Right now: %s. Do not rush me.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.confused.c: Did not get it, but I want to!
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.confused.l: Did not get it... Explain later.
What exactly? Show me in your off hand!
What? Show me in your off hand...
A sample in your off hand, please.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.give.curio: Here! There is a pebble too, it is pretty.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.stay.curio: Waiting! Can I look around here?
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.follow.cur: Let us go! Where? Never mind!
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.pause.curi: A break! Can I chase a butterfly meanwhile?
Protect? That is my thing! A place or you?
I am not very brave, but I will try. What to guard?
Protection? Exciting! Whom? You? A place?
Guarding... is that standing still? I can do that.
Guarding matters. A place or you?
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.guard.braw: Nobody gets past. Let them try.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.guard.gent: I will guard it. Do not go far.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.escort.bra: I am right here. Whoever touches you will regret it.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.escort.gen: I will stay close. Together it is not scary.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.escort.cur: With you! Where are we going?
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.escort.laz: Walking with you. Do not run.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.plans_guar: Guarding a place. Boring until someone shows up.
Guarding a place. Hope nobody comes.
Guarding a place! So much to see here.
Guarding a place. Very carefully. Eyes closed.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.plans_esco: Walking with you. Slowly, but walking.
arcane_artifacts.catto.loot.junk.brawler: %s? Rubbish, but I will take it.
arcane_artifacts.catto.loot.junk.gentle: I will take %s to the chest.
arcane_artifacts.catto.loot.junk.curious: %s! No idea why, but I need it!
arcane_artifacts.catto.loot.junk.lazy: %s... why did I pick that up.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.0.a.brawler: Saw a zombie yesterday. Ran from me like a good boy.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.0.b.brawler: Pff. I would not have let it go at all.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.0.a.gentle: The stone is so warm in the sun today...
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.0.b.gentle: Can I lie down next to you?
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.0.a.curious: Do you know why grass is green?
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.0.b.curious: No idea! Let us find out!
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.0.a.lazy: Mrr... a good day to do nothing.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.0.a.thrifty: I have two strings in my bag. One is spare.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.0.b.thrifty: There is no such thing as a spare string.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.1.a.brawler: Where is the fish? I am hungry as a skeleton.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.1.b.brawler: Fish is for the weak. Give me two.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.1.a.gentle: Does your owner give you fish too?
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.1.b.gentle: I get some when I work well.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.1.a.curious: I sniffed a fish. It smells of the sea!
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.1.b.curious: Does the sea smell of fish?
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.1.a.lazy: If the fish comes by itself, I will eat it.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.1.a.thrifty: Cod is cheaper than salmon. But salmon tastes better.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.1.b.thrifty: Fish is fish. As long as it is fresh.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.2.a.brawler: The villagers ran from me again. I only said hello.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.2.a.gentle: That villager in the green robe is kind.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.2.a.curious: Why do villagers have such big noses?
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.2.a.lazy: Villagers are noisy. Hmm-hmm all day.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.2.a.thrifty: Villagers trade emeralds for wheat. Odd economy.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.3.a.brawler: A creeper hissed at me yesterday. I hissed louder.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.3.a.gentle: I am afraid of creepers. They are so green.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.3.b.gentle: They fear us too. They say.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.3.a.lazy: Creepers fear us. That is handy.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.3.b.thrifty: Just not next to the chests.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.4.a.brawler: A full moon tonight. A good time for a fight.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.4.b.brawler: At night all monsters are mine.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.4.a.gentle: The moon is so pretty... like a bowl of milk.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.4.a.curious: If you stare at the moon long enough, will it wink?
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.4.a.lazy: The moon is up - time to sleep.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.4.a.thrifty: The chest is easier to see by moonlight.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.5.a.brawler: Last one to the well is wet!
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.5.a.gentle: Shall we be friends? I will bring you a fish.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.5.b.gentle: Yes! And I will give you a feather.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.5.a.curious: I found a box! There is another box inside!
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.5.b.curious: And another one in that one?
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.6.a.gentle: My owner pets me behind the ear.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.6.b.gentle: Mine too! So they are good.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.6.a.curious: My owner digs all the time. Why?
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.6.b.curious: Looking for diamonds. Or for himself.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.6.a.lazy: My owner lets me sleep. Sometimes.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.6.a.thrifty: My owner scatters cobblestone. I pick it up.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.7.a.gentle: It is dry under the awning. Come here.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.7.a.lazy: Rain is the best weather for sleeping.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.7.a.thrifty: Crops grow faster in the rain. That pays.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.7.b.thrifty: And the fur gets wet for free.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.8.a.brawler: I hear Mudzyas live in the caves. Must check.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.8.a.gentle: Mudzyas glow like little lanterns. I love them.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.8.a.curious: A Gribulka sneezed spores at me yesterday!
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.8.a.lazy: The Mushroom Caves... soft moss there. For sleeping.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.9.a.brawler: Shall I sing? Fine, but tell nobody.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.9.b.brawler: Singing is not fighting. But go on.
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.9.a.curious: Do you know songs? Teach me!
arcane_artifacts.catto.chat.9.a.lazy: I would sing... but I am lazy.
arcane_artifacts.page1.catto_village: Villages now have market stalls with striped awnings, little storerooms and junk piles - each with a Catto Cushion, and sooner or later a Catto settles there. Village Cattos stay by their cushion, sit on it, chat with each other and sometimes hum well-known tunes - Ode to Joy, Korobeiniki, Frère Jacques. You can make a cushion yourself too.
arcane_artifacts.page2.catto_village: Catto notices what lies around and decides what it needs: a better tool or weapon, a helmet or armor for an empty slot, food or torches for its second paw, materials for errands, fish. A Curious one takes the rest anyway; the others carry it to the main storage if one is bound. With the Cat Fishing Rod Catto fishes while you are by the water; whatever it wears shows on it.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.opt.name: Let me give you a name.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.name_ask.b: A name? Make it sound fierce.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.name_ask.g: A name? For me? Oh... what is it?
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.name_ask.c: A name! I wonder what? Write it!
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.named.curi: %s! What does it mean? Never mind, I like it!
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.name_ask.l: A name... Keep it short, I will have to answer to it.
arcane_artifacts.catto.dialog.name_ask.t: A name is serious business. Write it down.
item.arcane_artifacts.soul_lantern.lore: Something knocks quietly inside. Do not open.
Belt. Holds the souls you catch. Souls do not fly in by themselves: catch them with the Soul Flail or a chain.
A soul appears only when a player killed the mob: 35%, always with the Chain Sickle or under Reap.
Right click: throw the chain (12 blocks) and reel the first creature in to you.
Sneak + right click: grapple - the chain pulls you to a block or creature.
A creature killed with the sickle always leaves its soul; the sickle's chain catches soul wisps. It hooks Create Aeronautics ships too.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.shackled: Chains hold the creature on the spot: it can neither walk, jump nor teleport.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.reap_mark: If the creature dies marked, its soul flies into the lantern of whoever marked it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_chain: A chain flies from your hand; the first creature it hooks gets the rest of the spell and is reeled in to you. It hooks Create builds too: a minecart contraption is pulled, a Create Aeronautics ship is winched in. With Dampen the chain reels you to the target - you can leap onto a flying ship. Bosses are too heavy to pull.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_chain_gly: Reels you to the target instead of the target to you.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_chain: Tip: do not hook a ghast. The ghast will not come down. You will go up.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_chain: How it works: a form. The chain flies up to 12 blocks; the first creature gets the rest of the spell and is reeled in to you (up to 1.25 s). With Dampen you are reeled - to the creature or to a block, like a grappling hook. Creatures over 150 health and bosses are not pulled.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_shackl: Chains rise from the ground and hold the target on the spot for 3 seconds: it can neither walk, jump nor teleport. A Create contraption (bearing, piston, minecart, train) stops; a Create Aeronautics ship stands still, twice as long, whatever its engines do. Bosses are held half as long, at most once every 20 seconds.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_shackle_g: The chains hold one second longer.
Chains every creature around the point.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_shackl: Tip: a shackled enderman is deeply offended. Silently. It stares for a very long time.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_shackle: How it works: Shackled for 3 s (+1 s per Extend Time). The creature cannot walk or jump, knockback does not move it, endermen and chorus fruit cannot teleport it. Bosses: half as long, then 20 s of immunity. A Create Aeronautics ship is held where the chains caught it: it neither flies nor turns until the shackle ends.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_reap: Marks a creature for 5 seconds. If it dies marked, its soul flies straight into your Soul Lantern, whoever dealt the last blow.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_reap_glyp: The mark lasts two seconds longer.
A weak soul (wandering, beast, drowned) comes out cursed.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_reap: Tip: a chicken's soul is a soul too. Technically. The lantern disagrees.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_reap: How it works: a mark for 5 s (+2 s per Extend Time). A creature that dies marked gives its soul straight to your lantern (100%). With Amplify a weak soul becomes Cursed. If the lantern is full, the soul stays a wisp.
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Shackling
Souls do not vanish. They are just badly tied down. A chain is a polite way of asking them to stay.
Hurt a creature with Harm
Catch a creature with Snare
Suffer Wither yourself
A soul holds on to what holds it. Unlocks the Soul Lantern, the Chain Sickle and the Chain, Shackle and Reap glyphs.
item.arcane_artifacts.warden_rod.desc.1: Right click a creature: every servant attacks it. Right click your servant: follow / guard its spot.
item.arcane_artifacts.warden_rod.desc.2: Sneak + right click a servant: dismiss it (its soul goes back to the lantern).
item.arcane_artifacts.warden_rod.desc.3: Right click the air: all follow. Sneak + right click: all guard the spot you look at.
arcane_artifacts.ritual_desc.ritual_awak: A Novice of the Shackled offers ten souls from the Soul Lantern and becomes an Overseer: servants, Raise Dead, Devour and Bond open up.
arcane_artifacts.necro.ritual.not_novice: The ritual does not answer: finish the Shackling research first.
arcane_artifacts.necro.ritual.need_souls: You need %s souls in your Soul Lantern.
arcane_artifacts.necro.ritual.awakened: The chains know you now. You are an Overseer.
arcane_artifacts.necro.no_souls: Not enough souls in the lantern.
arcane_artifacts.necro.no_mana_room: Your servants already hold too much of your mana.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_raise_: Overseer rank. Spends souls from your lantern and raises a servant chained to you. Your souls decide which, strongest first.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_raise_dea: Raises one more servant, if souls and your limit allow.
Spends only weak souls (skeleton, hound, rower).
Raises a Bone Porter (4 wandering souls).
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_raise_: Tip: servants never take a day off. They never say thank you either.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_raise_d: How it works: the servant depends on your souls - void + 2 wandering: Shadow Assassin; blazing + 3: Burning Knight; cursed + 3: Plague Doctor; 2 drowned: Drowned Rower; 2 beast: Ghost Hound; 3 wandering: Chained Skeleton. Servant limit: 2 / 3 / 5 by rank. Each servant holds part of your maximum mana (5-12%, 70% in all at most). Beyond 24 blocks the chain breaks and the servant crumbles, giving back its key soul.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_devour: Overseer rank. Burns the weakest soul in your lantern: heals 3 hearts, or refills mana with Sensitive.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_devour: Tip: tastes like chicken. All souls taste like chicken.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_devour: How it works: takes the weakest soul. Healing: 6 health. Mana (with Sensitive): weak soul 25, blazing/void 40, cursed 60, great/pure 400. The glyph itself costs no mana.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_bond: Overseer rank. Chains the target to the nearest creature: for 8 seconds damage to either one is split between both.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_bond_glyp: The bond lasts two seconds longer.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_bond: Tip: bond two creepers. See what happens. From far away.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_bond: How it works: a chain between the target and the nearest creature within 6 blocks for 8 s (+2 s per Extend Time). Damage to one: half to it, half to the other. Snaps on death or when they are 16 blocks apart.
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Awakening
A soul in a lantern is a resource. A soul in bones is a worker. The only difference is who holds the chain.
Mark a creature with Reap
Shackle a creature
Cast a spell with the Chain form
Chains hold more than the living. Unlocks the Warden's Rod, the Awakening ritual and the Raise Dead, Devour and Bond glyphs.
item.arcane_artifacts.shackle_gloves.des: Hands. Chains fly 1.5 times farther, shackles hold one second longer.
item.arcane_artifacts.shroud.desc.1: Back. Servants rise with 30% more health. +75 maximum mana.
item.arcane_artifacts.bone_crown.desc.1: Head. +1 servant. Undead weaker than your rank do not attack first (Overseer: zombies and skeletons; Chainlord: wither skeletons too).
item.arcane_artifacts.bone_crown.desc.2: Shackled set. Bosses and undead you hit behave as usual.
arcane_artifacts.set.shackled.bonus: Chain Reaction: a fallen servant lashes up to 3 enemies nearby with its chain (5 + 2 per rank damage); 15% of caught souls come one step stronger.
item.arcane_artifacts.ritual_dagger.desc: A creature killed with the dagger always leaves its soul.
Killing a shackled creature is a proper ritual: Corruption -1.
item.arcane_artifacts.soul_vessel.desc.1: Right click: take the weakest soul from your lantern (sneak: the strongest). Keep it, trade it, give it away.
item.arcane_artifacts.soul_vessel.desc.2: Right click: put the soul back into your lantern.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.phantom: Nothing can hurt you and creatures lose sight of you, but you cannot attack.
arcane_artifacts.corruption.villager_ref: The villager recoils: you smell of the crypt.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_phanto: Overseer rank. For 2 seconds you are a phantom: nothing can hurt you and creatures lose sight of you, but you cannot attack. If a wall one block thick stands right in front of you, you step through it.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_phantom_s: One second longer as a phantom.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_phanto: Tip: walls two blocks thick do not believe in ghosts.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_phantom: How it works: Phantom for 2 s (+1 s per Extend Time) plus invisibility. No damage gets through (except the void), mobs drop you as a target, you cannot attack. A wall exactly 1 block thick where you look (up to 2 high): you come out on the other side.
A piece of soul on a chain. Do not lose it. Seriously.

Neck. Sneak + right click a block: bind it to that place. If you die wearing it, you come back there alive (half health) with everything; then it sleeps for 3 in-game days. While bound it slowly feeds Corruption. Overseer rank.
Right click: change its look (only the look): crow skull, caged heart, hourglass, black stone, rag doll. Shackled set.
arcane_artifacts.phylactery.unbound: Not bound (sneak + right click a block)
arcane_artifacts.phylactery.saved: Death recoils: the phylactery tears you back.
item.arcane_artifacts.shackled_boots.des: Feet. Heavy: half the knockback, and nobody's chain can pull you.
On soul sand, soul soil and graveyard soil you run faster. Shackled set.
item.arcane_artifacts.gravedigger_shovel: Right click a grave to dig it up: bones, old trinkets, sometimes a soul... and sometimes the tenant.
arcane_artifacts.soul_eater.stole: The Soul Eater tore out of your lantern: %s!
arcane_artifacts.soul_eater.coming: Something hungry has smelled your souls...
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.cursed_chain: Chains hold you and poison you: no walking, jumping, teleporting or healing, and your hits are a quarter weaker. From Curse of Shackles. Milk does not help; a Shackle Key does.
item.arcane_artifacts.shackle_key.desc.1: Right-click: frees you and allies within 4 blocks from shackles, entanglement and cursed chains.
item.arcane_artifacts.executioner_axe.de: In a Chainlord's hands it executes creatures at 15% health or less (not bosses).
An executed soul is always one grade stronger.
arcane_artifacts.ritual_desc.ritual_eter: Chainlords only. Your nearest servant within 6 blocks of the brazier becomes eternal: it no longer crumbles away from you and it gains levels. Costs one cursed soul and 1000 Source; at most three eternal servants.
arcane_artifacts.necro.ritual.need_curse: You need a cursed soul in your Soul Lantern.
arcane_artifacts.necro.ritual.bound_limi: You already have three eternal servants.
arcane_artifacts.necro.ritual.bound: The chain is forged for ever.
arcane_artifacts.necro.ritual.no_servant: None of your servants stands near the brazier.
arcane_artifacts.necro.chainlord: The Jailer has fallen. His chains are yours now: you are a Chainlord.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_curse_: Chainlord rank. The target is bound in cursed chains for 8 seconds: it cannot move, teleport or heal, and hits a quarter weaker.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_curse_of_: The curse lasts two seconds longer.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_curse_: Tip: a healing potion at this point is just expensive water.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_curse_o: How it works: Cursed Chains for 8 s (+2 s per Extend Time). Healing is cancelled, outgoing damage x0.75, no teleporting. The target counts as held by you for Chain Execution. On players it works like PvP shackles (with immunity afterwards).
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_chain_: Chainlord rank. Everyone your chains hold within 16 blocks (up to 8 targets) takes damage at once: 4 + Corruption/10.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_chain_: Tip: shackle first, execute second. The other way round works worse.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_chain_e: How it works: hits only creatures under Shackles or Cursed Chains cast by you. Damage 4 + Corruption/10 + 2 per Amplify, up to 8 targets within 16 blocks. The deeper the Corruption, the harder it bites.
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Chainlord
An Overseer holds servants. A Chainlord holds everything else, including whoever used to hold him.
Raise the dead
Bind a creature with Bond
Shackle a wither skeleton

A chain can be cursed and pulled tight. Unlocks Curse of Shackles, Chain Execution and the Eternal Binding ritual. The Chainlord rank itself is earned by defeating the Jailer in a Soul Dungeon (Soul Sand Valley, Nether).
arcane_artifacts.throne.no_soul: You need a great soul in your Soul Lantern.
arcane_artifacts.throne.occupied: Something already stands on this pillar.
arcane_artifacts.throne.wrong_order: Wrong order! The lanterns go out and the Restless crawl out of the throne.
arcane_artifacts.throne.incomplete: The throne is not built: a 5x5 Shackle Stone floor, 3-high Chain Pillars on the corners, the throne in the middle.
arcane_artifacts.throne.need_lanterns: %s of 4 Great Soul Lanterns are lit.
arcane_artifacts.throne.need_night: The King wakes only at night (outside the Overworld, at any time).
arcane_artifacts.throne.summoned: Chains come down from the sky. The King rises.
arcane_artifacts.imprisoned_king.tears: The King tears your servant's chain!
"The Throne of Chains. To wake the King:"
1. A 5x5 Shackle Stone floor, the Empty Throne in the middle.
2. Chain Pillars, 3 blocks high, on the corners.
3. A Soul Lantern on top of each pillar (right click) spends a great soul. Order: north-west, north-east, south-east, south-west.
4. At night, a Shackle Key on the throne. Get the lantern order wrong and you have only yourself to blame.
While the locks on the pillars stand, the King cannot be hurt. Break the locks.
item.arcane_artifacts.shackle_key.desc.2: Needed to wake the Imprisoned King on the Throne of Chains.
item.arcane_artifacts.scythe_of_the_reap: Every blow sweeps a half circle in front of you: everyone else there takes 60% damage.
Right click - Harvest: 6 damage to every foe within 8 blocks; souls of those who fall in the next 3 s go into your lantern. Every 90 s.
item.arcane_artifacts.kings_crown.desc.1: Head. Everything the Bone Crown does, but +2 servants instead of one. Counts as the Shackled set's crown.
item.arcane_artifacts.tooth_necklace.des: Relic. Every fifth soul you spend adds no Corruption.
item.arcane_artifacts.executioner_ring.d: Relic. The Executioner's Axe executes at 25% health already.
item.arcane_artifacts.jailer_eye.desc.1: Relic. Your servants and soul wisps within 32 blocks show through walls.
item.arcane_artifacts.caged_heart.desc.1: Relic. A killing blow leaves you at 1 health with three souls in your lantern.
item.arcane_artifacts.caged_heart.desc.2: Then it sleeps for 10 minutes. Beats before the Phylactery.
arcane_artifacts.relic.caged_heart.beat: The Caged Heart beat for you.
arcane_artifacts.ritual_desc.ritual_conv: A Chainlord at 99 Corruption, wearing a bound Phylactery Amulet, burns a great soul and becomes a Lich. There is no way back.
arcane_artifacts.necro.ritual.need_great: You need a great soul in your Soul Lantern.
arcane_artifacts.necro.ritual.lich: Your heart stops. You are a Lich.
arcane_artifacts.throne.start_north_west: The first lantern goes on the north-west pillar.
item.arcane_artifacts.soul_flail.desc.1: A blow on a soul wisp catches it in your lantern. Reaches a block farther and knocks shields down.
item.arcane_artifacts.soul_flail.desc.2: Every 10 blows on living creatures chip together a Wandering Soul.
arcane_artifacts.soul_flail.shards_soul: The shards stick together into a soul.
arcane_artifacts.soul_wisp.no_lantern: The soul has nowhere to go: wear a Soul Lantern on your belt.
arcane_artifacts.soul_wisp.slips: The soul slips through the blow. Catch it with the Soul Flail or a chain.
item.arcane_artifacts.mystery_hat.desc.1: Echo: a spell has a 20% chance to cost no mana, 40% while you have less than half your mana.
arcane_artifacts.druid.rooted: The roots hold you. Death can wait.
Five staves in one. The circle key (B) switches the spell.
15% cheaper and a quarter faster than the single staves.
arcane_artifacts.druid_staff.no_ground: The thorns find nothing to root in: you need earth ahead of you.
arcane_artifacts.druid_circle.roots.desc: projectile, vines hold the target and everything around it for 3 s
arcane_artifacts.druid_circle.grove.desc: projectile, everything growing around grows and ripe crops are gathered
arcane_artifacts.druid_circle.hive.desc: projectile, angry bees fall upon the target
arcane_artifacts.druid_circle.sap.desc: heals you and allies nearby, plus Regeneration for 5 s
arcane_artifacts.druid_circle.thorns.des: a wall of thorny bushes 3 blocks ahead, 15 s, 40 mana

item.arcane_artifacts.oath_shield.desc.1: Warden. Right click an anchor during a Pairing: confirm it (you become the Warden).
item.arcane_artifacts.oath_shield.desc.2: Outside a rite: light an anchor; during it: mend an anchor (+25); at the end: confirm the outer seal (+3%).

arcane_artifacts.cult.seal_now: Confirm the outer seal with the shield at an anchor!

arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Initiation
One holds the circle. The other speaks the words. If both know their task, what was promised rises from the ash. If not, usually only the repair bill rises.
Study a red candle
Study a bone block

A rite takes two. Unlocks the Ritual Seal, the anchors, the Ritual Knife and the Oath Shield. Hellmerus's note: "I asked why they need a second person. They said the first one is usually busy not dying."
item.arcane_artifacts.seal_hammer.desc.1: Warden. Right click an anchor during a rite: mend +40 (once a second).
item.arcane_artifacts.seal_hammer.desc.2: The Call: a blow on a creature turns every ordinary hostile within 8 blocks on you (every 10 s).
item.arcane_artifacts.seal_hammer.desc.3: Sneak + right click the air: the Seal of Shelter on your Confessor (within 16): 4 s of 60% less damage and no knockback, every 18 s.
Right click: your role, your partner (where and how far), the nearest circle, reagents, rite quality.
Sneak + right click the seal: choose its rite.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.warded: The Warden's Seal of Shelter: for 4 seconds 60% less damage and no knockback.
arcane_artifacts.knife_inlay.current: Inlay: %s (inlay in the other hand + right click to change)
arcane_artifacts.cult.hammer_rite_only: The hammer mends anchors during a rite; the shield lights them.
arcane_artifacts.cult.ward_cooldown: The Warding Seal has not cooled yet.
arcane_artifacts.cult.ward_no_confessor: Your Confessor is not within 16 blocks.
arcane_artifacts.cult.book.partner_away: Your partner is not in this world or not online.
item.arcane_artifacts.seal_keeper_helm.d: Head, +3 armour. Anchors near you (8 blocks) take 40% less from the acolytes.
Creatures hunting your partner glow. Keeper of the Circle set.
item.arcane_artifacts.outer_circle_cuira: The Interception takes 40% of a blow on the Confessor instead of 30%. Keeper of the Circle set.
item.arcane_artifacts.anchor_belt.desc.1: Belt. 4 charges: a shield mend gives +35 more. Every blocked blow returns a charge.
item.arcane_artifacts.anchor_belt.desc.2: A block in the first half second is a parry: half the blow goes back to the attacker. Keeper of the Circle set.
item.arcane_artifacts.seal_gauntlets.des: Hands. Shield mends 1.5 times stronger, the Hammer +15 more.
Your blow knocks that creature's arrows and missiles within 4 blocks out of the air. Keeper of the Circle set.
Feet, −60% knockback. In the outer ring of your rite: Resistance I.
Crouch and stand still for 2 s: the stance, −30% damage until you move. Keeper of the Circle set.
item.arcane_artifacts.face_of_dogma.desc: Head, +60 mana. Inscription windows 0.3 s wider.
Inscribed creatures around you glow for everyone. Voice of the Rite set.
item.arcane_artifacts.communion_mantle.d: Body, +30 mana. Blows on you during a rite cost the rite half as much.
Below 30% health: 3 s of smoke veil, invisible and −50% damage (every 90 s). Voice of the Rite set.
item.arcane_artifacts.book_of_arrears.de: Belt. The seal takes the missing reagents from your pack.
Every broken rite gives +1% to the start of the next (up to +10%). Voice of the Rite set.
item.arcane_artifacts.inscriber_hands.de: Hands, +30 mana. A strike in the window is worth +1% more, a miss costs 1% instead of 3%.
A Ritual Knife blow marks the creature Inscribed (10 s), every 5 s. Voice of the Rite set.
item.arcane_artifacts.quiet_shoes.desc.1: Feet. While you sneak, your steps do not wake sculk or the Warden.
arcane_artifacts.set.circle_keeper.bonus: Full set: −10% damage from creatures while your Confessor is within 8 blocks; once a minute you take a killing blow meant for your Confessor.
arcane_artifacts.set.voice_of_rite.bonus: Full set: every strike in a window +2% more (up to +10% a rite), the close counts twice. Both in full sets: +5% to the rite.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.inscribed: The Confessor's mark. The Face of Dogma shows it through walls; the Cultist glyphs (later) bite harder on it.
arcane_artifacts.cult.keeper_took: You took the blow for your Confessor.
arcane_artifacts.cult.keeper_saved: Your Warden took the killing blow for you.
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Servants of the Circle
A circle is not held by stone. It is held by the one who does not leave it, and the one who does not lose the formula.
Study Vow Dust
Study Ritual Ash
Unlocks the Keeper of the Circle (Warden) and Voice of the Rite (Confessor) sets. The rank of Servants of the Circle comes with three steady rites.
Voices of Dogma
A formula said twice stops being a request and becomes a promise. Promises here are kept.
Study a red candle
Study Vow Dust

A Servant of the Circle becomes a Voice of Dogma once the Archdeacon has fallen before them (the Archive of Unkept Promises) and they have held a Perfect rite (95%+), in either order. It opens Abundance and the Second Coming in the Book of Formulas.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_inscri: Form. The ritual sign lands on the creature you look at (16 blocks): Inscribed for 30 s, and the rest of the spell follows it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_inscri: Tip: write legibly. The acolytes read syllable by syllable.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_inscrib: How it works: a look ray of 16 blocks (+8 per Accelerate). The first creature is Inscribed for 30 s and gets the rest of the spell; with no creature the spell resolves on the block. Red Acolytes go for the Inscribed first; Retribution gives your summons Strength against them.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_inscribe_: Inside your rite's circle: its anchors gain 10 stability.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_wardin: A short protective circle around the point (radius 3, 4 s): you, your partner and your rite summons inside take 60% less damage and no knockback. Once in 8 s.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_wardin: Tip: the seal guards the circle, not your confidence.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_warding: How it works: a circle of radius 3 (+1 per AOE) for 4 s (+2 s per Extend Time). Twice a second it Wards those inside: the caster, their partner and the pair's rite-summoned creatures. Strangers are not covered. Cooldown 8 s.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_warding_s: The circle is a block wider.
Inside your rite's circle: its anchors gain 10 stability.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_witnes: Form. Only for a pair: with your partner within the link range, a faint Ash Witness rises where you look for 30 s and the rest of the spell resolves on it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_witnes: Tip: a witness comes only if someone can confirm you called.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_witness: How it works: needs your bound partner online within 16 blocks (alone in creative). The witness rises within 12 blocks where you look and lasts 30 s (+10 s per Extend Time). Amplify: a common witness instead of a faint one; Census: one more faint one each; Abundance: a better loot roll. At most three called witnesses per player, once in 5 s.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_witness_c: A common witness instead of a faint one.
One more faint witness instead of a stronger one.
+0.25 to their loot multiplier (up to x1.5).
Inside your rite's circle: its anchors gain 10 stability.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_hold_c: Augment. A spell cast inside the circle of your rite steadies it: every anchor gains 10 stability per Hold (once in 2 s).
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_hold_c: Tip: a circle stands on stone, on an oath and on you not leaving for tea.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_hold_ci: How it works: fits the Cultist glyphs. If you are the Confessor or the Warden of a running rite and stand in its circle (6 blocks), every anchor gains 10 stability per Hold. Once in 2 s.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_retrib: Your rite summons within 24 blocks attack the target. Against an Inscribed target they gain Strength for 10 s.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_retrib: Tip: pointing is rude. Pointing with acolytes is effective.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_retribu: How it works: every creature raised by the pair's rites (or the Witness Call) within 24 blocks of the target takes it as its target. Against an Inscribed target: Strength I (+1 per Amplify) for 10 s. Abundance: +0.1 to each obeying summon's loot multiplier, once. Never on players or your own.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_retributi: Strength one level higher against the Inscribed.
+0.1 to the loot multiplier of each summon that obeys.
Inside your rite's circle: its anchors gain 10 stability.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_census: Augment. Changes what the Witness Call brings: one more faint creature instead of one strengthened.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_census: Tip: the census counts everyone. Especially those who were not here yesterday.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_census: How it works: each Census in a Witness Call adds one more faint witness, but Amplify then does nothing: they all stay faint.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_rite_a: Augment. Raises the extra roll of ordinary loot from rite summons.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_rite_a: Tip: abundance is when there is more ash than questions about it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_rite_ab: How it works: in the Witness Call +0.25 to the loot multiplier per Abundance (up to x1.5); in Retribution +0.1 to each obeying summon (once, up to x2). The bonus covers only ritual_loot whitelisted materials and only rite-summoned creatures.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_second: Needs both of the pair: the Confessor and the Warden cast it during their rite within 2 s of each other — the rite gains 8% quality, the anchors 20 stability. Once per rite.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_second: Tip: a prayer in two voices sounds more convincing. And louder.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_second_: How it works: each of the pair casts a spell with Second Voice during their rite. If both voices sound within 2 s: +8% quality, +20 to every anchor, once per rite. Does not work in a solo rite.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_second_vo: Inside your rite's circle: its anchors gain 10 stability.
arcane_artifacts.cult.call_no_partner: The call goes unheard: your partner is far away or offline.
arcane_artifacts.cult.call_cooldown: The witnesses are not ready to answer yet.
arcane_artifacts.cult.voice_no_rite: The Second Voice needs a running rite.
arcane_artifacts.cult.voice_waiting: Your voice has sounded. Waiting for the second.
arcane_artifacts.cult.voice_done: Two voices became one: the rite grows stronger.
item.arcane_artifacts.archdeacon_seal.lo: Taken from the one who tested the pairs. They say it opens what lies below the Archive.
arcane_artifacts.cult.rank_needs_archdea: Voices of Dogma now needs the Archdeacon's fall in the Archive of Unkept Promises. You are a Servant of the Circle until he falls.
arcane_artifacts.cult.archdeacon_fell: The Archdeacon fell before you. A perfect rite will open Voices of Dogma to you.
arcane_artifacts.cult.archdeacon_cover: The Archdeacon raises a seal over the Confessor - Warden, to them!
arcane_artifacts.cult.archdeacon_unison: Two points flare - stand on them together, at once!
arcane_artifacts.cult.archive_holding: You hold the seal. Stay by it: your partner must light the candle.
arcane_artifacts.cult.archive_renegade: A renegade at the seal - the hold is broken.
arcane_artifacts.cult.archive_need_holde: The candle will not burn while no one else holds the Holding Seal.
